additional_info.subject: ID0460939-DC/Si-D/CZ-[RVP / T3 170004527] Missing Converters in DC4 CRM:03042000273
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0467836
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-CZ SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP/T7170003581
Charger ID / Serial No.:
zSPWXi
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
After following the error flag, we can see that there are missing converters in DC4. There are three possible solutions:​​​​​​
​​​​​​​
Check the cable connecting to the converter. If the cable is also fine, continue.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it, just to confirm whether the problem is the Fast Shutdown cable or to the converter.
If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-CZ SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Younes Baroudi
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
